intro: I'm Sachin Raj. My work focuses on building and validating technical systems.

My background is in mechanical engineering, with professional experience in regulated healthcare technology, including genomic diagnostics, clinical data, bioinformatics workflows, and enterprise systems. Much of my work has focused on validation, data quality, and ensuring systems produce reliable and reproducible results.
I'm applying that experience to robotics and physical systems, with a focus on building, testing, and validating robotic systems, sensors, and their supporting software.

contact.note: Open to research collaboration, technical questions about the tools or papers, and conversations with engineers working on robotic systems and validation methodology.
